opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Center
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services, through the Office of Civil Justice and the Mayor’s Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence, is renewing a contract to provide core civil legal services at the city’s five Family Justice Centers. The work supplies immigration‑related legal assistance—including application help, representation before immigration agencies and courts, and support for self‑represented clients—to survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence.

opportunities.title: In-Person/VRI interpretation for Spoken Languages Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) seeks three vendors to provide in‑person and video remote interpretation for spoken languages, Deaf/Hard‑of‑Hearing interpretation, language services, and written translation. These services will support ACS and its network of providers in complying with Local Law 73, Local Law 30, the ADA Title II and Title VI requirements for limited‑English‑proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The contracts will be awarded via a competitive sealed‑proposal process for a three‑year term from July 1 2026 to June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing Language Access Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) ISLA division is awarding a competitive sealed proposal contract for in‑person, on‑site, and video remote sign language interpretation, including American Sign Language, Certified Deaf Interpretation, foreign sign languages, and Communication Access Realtime Translation (CART) services. The services will support ACS and its network of providers in meeting legal accessibility obligations for deaf/hard‑of‑hearing and limited‑English‑proficient families, with the contract term running from July 1 2026 to June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Translation Services
opportunities.summary: The ACS Immigrant Services and Language Affairs division is seeking three vendors to provide in‑person and video‑remote interpretation for spoken languages and Deaf/Hard‑of‑Hearing, as well as written translation services for limited‑English‑proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The work will be awarded through a competitive sealed proposals process for contracts running from July 1 2026 to June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - NYCitizenship Program
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide legal screenings and services to participants in the NYCitizenship Program. The work includes free assistance guiding clients through the naturalization process to help them qualify for SSI and reduce reliance on DSS benefits.

opportunities.title: Outside Land Use & Zoning Counsel with respect to the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay Project
opportunities.address: One Liberty Plaza, 165 Broadway, 14th Floor Mailroom, New York, NY 10006
opportunities.summary: NYCEDC is seeking law firms to provide outside legal counsel services to analyze, draft, and review applications for tax‑lot apportionments and zoning‑lot subdivisions for Manhattan Tax Block 962, part of Lot 100, supporting the SPARC Kips Bay development. The work will be awarded through a Request for Proposals under the NYCEDC procurement process.

opportunities.title: American Sign Language (ASL) Interpretation
opportunities.address: 100 Church Street, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10007
opportunities.summary: The Campaign Finance Board is awarding a negotiated acquisition extension to provide American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation services. The contract, valued up to $99,999, will run from August 1, 2025 through July 31, 2027.
